responsibility: This file implements simple case-conversion helpers for the mc-boot runtime. It provides whole-string uppercase and lowercase copying routines over fixed character arrays and single-character ASCII case mapping functions, making it the dedicated text-case utility layer rather than a general string-manipulation module.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the executable implementation of the GStrCase pair, containing the ASCII case-mapping logic and whole-string copy loops that use StrLib and ASCII constants; gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStrCase.h only publishes those routines' prototypes.
